board: AZ-Delivery 1.3 inch OLED I2C Display 128x64 (SH1106, 4-pin VDD GND SCK SDA)
reason: Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator text-on-screen test, routed PCB with DRC clean, footprint, LCSC). The driver follows the SH1106 datasheet: 0x80/0x40 control bytes, DC-DC on (AD 8B), page addressing from column 2 of 132, 100 ms wait after AF. The clock pin is named SCL because the simulator finds the I2C bus by that name; the AZ-Delivery silkscreen reads SCK, and the pin description says so.
